SELECT
  date_bin('$__interval', ts) AS "time",
  AVG("TC_HG_01") AS "TC-HG-01"
FROM
  "public"."labviewtest"
WHERE
  ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime
GROUP BY
  date_bin('$__interval', ts)
ORDER BY
  "time" ASC
